mentions.name: YAML Resume
mentions.description: An open source Node.js library that lets people create and version control resumes using YAML. It renders LaTeX/PDF/Markdown output in one shot with professional typesetting, supports English, Chinese, Norwegian, and French out of the box, and provides clang-style real-time error reporting. HTML output is planned for an upcoming release.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://yamlresume.dev

A open source Node.js lib that allows people to create and version control resumes using YAML.

Support LaTeX/PDF/Markdown outputs in one shot with professional typesetting.
Support English/Chinese/Norwegian/French languages out of the box.
With clang style, real time error reporting.

To release soon: HTML output.
